metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the Rust CLI tool in `output/` (no external dependencies; empty `[dependencies]`).

- Builds/runs with `cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml` and `cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- --input <path> --output <path>`
- Supports actions: `inspect`, `render`, `inspect_gedzip`, `render_gedzip`
- Parses GEDCOM into a canonical JSON tree (with `CONT` folded into parent `payload` using `\n`) and renders the tree back to GEDCOM text
- Validates key GEDCOM constraints (line grammar, level nesting, xref rules, `HEAD`/`TRLR` requirements, `CONT` placement) and returns structured errors
- Reads/writes GEDZIP as ZIP (stored method only) with `gedcom.ged` plus base64 attachments

Entry point: `output/src/main.rs:1`
